guide.start.title: Quick start
guide.start.items: **Plug the microphone** straight into a USB port of the computer, without hubs.
**Install the driver** with the “Install the driver” button. Windows asks for administrator permission; the sound pauses for a couple of seconds.
**Run Smart setup** on the Overview page: 4 seconds of silence and a phrase — the panel picks noise suppression, gain and tone for you.
**Choose the microphone in your apps**: “Microphone (Samson C01U Pro Mic)”. The processing already works in Discord, OBS, Zoom, Telegram and games.
You can close the panel: the driver keeps working without it. The tray icon is needed for the hotkey and monitoring.
guide.position.title: How to use the C01U Pro
guide.position.items: The C01U Pro is a **side-address microphone**: speak into the side with the Samson logo, not into the top.
**Keep 10–20 cm**. Closer gives more bass and pops, further gives more room echo.
A **pop filter** or foam windscreen stops “p” and “b” better than any processing; the digital pop filter is extra insurance.
**Do not knock the desk** — use a shock mount or a stand on a soft pad.
The pickup pattern ignores the back and the sides: **put noise sources (the PC, a fan) behind the microphone**.
Keep the Windows level at **80–100%** and set the loudness with “Input gain” in the panel.
guide.monitor.title: Hearing yourself
guide.monitor.items: The C01U Pro has a **headphone jack with a volume knob** — zero-latency monitoring, but without processing.
“Listen to myself” in the panel plays the **processed sound** with a small delay (about 50–80 ms) — handy for checking noise suppression and effects.
Use **headphones**, not speakers, otherwise you get feedback (howling).
The “Original” mode lets you hear how the microphone would sound without the driver.
guide.apps.title: Setting up apps
guide.apps.items: **Discord**: Settings → Voice & Video → Input device “Samson C01U Pro”. Turn off Discord's noise suppression and automatic gain control — the driver already does it.
**OBS Studio**: add “Audio Input Capture” with Samson C01U Pro. No extra OBS filters are needed.
**Zoom / Teams / Telegram**: choose Samson C01U Pro and set the built-in noise suppression to “Low” or “Off”.
**Games**: if a game does not let you choose a microphone, make Samson the default device (button in Diagnostics).
Apps that use **exclusive or ASIO mode** (some music software) bypass Windows processing — for them use “Routing” to a virtual cable in Settings.
guide.features.title: What the panel can do
guide.features.items: **Noise suppression** without neural networks: a spectral algorithm removes hiss, PC and air-conditioner noise without eating the voice.
**Digital pop filter** catches air bursts on “p”, “b”, “t”.
**Gate** closes the microphone in pauses; “automatic threshold” follows the room noise by itself.
**Auto level** evens out loudness when you speak quieter or louder or lean away.
**Compressor and limiter** make the voice dense and protect against clipping.
A **10-band equalizer** with draggable points plus quick “Warmth”, “Clarity” and “Air” knobs.
**Voice effects**: robot, walkie-talkie, telephone, deep and high voice, echo, hall.
**A/B test**: record a phrase and switch between “before” and “after”.
**LUFS loudness meter**, voice pitch detector, spectrum and waterfall.
guide.hotkeys.title: Hotkeys and tricks
guide.hotkeys.items: **Ctrl + Alt + M** mutes or unmutes the microphone in any app (change it in Settings). A short sound tells you the state.
Click the tray icon to open the panel, right-click for the quick menu.
Double-click a slider to return the default value.
In the equalizer drag the points, use the mouse wheel to change the width (Q) and double-click to add a band or reset its gain.
guide.trouble.title: If something does not work
guide.trouble.items: Run **Diagnostics** — it checks the connection, access, levels, the driver and noise, and offers one-click fixes.
**The microphone is silent**: check Windows Settings → Privacy → Microphone and that Samson is not disabled in sound settings.
**The driver is not active** after installation: press “Restart audio” or reboot the computer.
**You changed the USB port** — Windows creates a new device; press “Connect” in the banner.
**Crackles and dropouts**: plug the microphone into a port on the back of the PC, without extension cables or hubs.
If something goes wrong, the driver can be **removed in one click** — Windows sound settings go back to how they were.
guide.tech.title: How it works
guide.tech.items: The driver is an **audio processing object (APO)** that Windows builds into the microphone's sound path, so all apps get the improved sound at once.
The standard Windows USB driver of the C01U Pro stays in place — nothing is replaced or broken.
Processing takes **less than 1% of one CPU core** and adds about 12 ms of latency. No neural networks are used.
The panel is a light web interface on your own computer (127.0.0.1) — nothing is sent to the internet.
guide.remove.title: Uninstalling
guide.remove.items: Settings → Driver → “Uninstall the driver”, or Windows Settings → Apps → C01U Pro Studio.
Uninstalling restores the original Windows sound settings from the backup and turns off autostart.
